scope: Exact paired-seam cancellation, bolt coordinate/domain transfer test and a whole-remainder numerical target. No numerical full heat residual or signed projection is claimed.
ordinary_argument_review: The exact image-trace cancellation is applied to the actual paired domain and its C2,1 reflected coefficient. The analytic interior continuation is a comparison only; its boundary difference remains in the error.
Conformal variation at fixed proper coordinate includes -f' integral(v). Fixed-z observation and density changes also remain.
No odd warping variation occurs below weight seven. Every boundary difference contains an odd jet; combining seed weight three and variation weight four starts at seven.
The full boundary remainder has a qualitative integrable O(t^3) trace allowance with a bounded smearing. No numerical heat-calculus constant is inferred from this order.
The actual smooth disk has an unbounded reciprocal-warping logarithmic derivative in the cylinder coordinate. Regularity of the disk and failure of the cylinder bound are compatible.
The critical thermal radial channel requires the regular log-free extension; square integrability alone is insufficient. Symbolic j covers all thermal frequencies.
The intrinsic diagonal L1 norm and its sufficient target refer to the entire response. Its numerical value remains unknown, as does certification of the full signed projection.

sources.use: Smooth strongly elliptic physical-half heat parametrix and boundary jet weights, sections 2 and 5. No quantitative constant or rough-base theorem is imported.
